So fuel consumption in gallons per mile: 8.2 L / 3.78541 = 2.166 gallons per 62.137 miles => 0.03486 gallons per mile. So mpg = 1 / 0.03486 = 28.7 mpg. With 42 gallons, range = 42 * 28.7 = 1205 miles. Actually we have fuel range 560 km = 348 miles. Wait discrepancy. The metadata shows fuel range 560 km remaining. That's 348 miles. So with 348 miles range, cannot cover 980 miles. So answer: distance 980 miles, fuel range 348 miles, insufficient. Provide suggestion: fill fuel tank.
